name: Lees
overview: The biblical concept of lees, or the settlings of wine, symbolizes both refinement and spiritual complacency. Isaiah 25:6 portrays wines on the lees as part of a divinely prepared feast, indicating a process of purification and richness. Conversely, Jeremiah 48:11 and Zephaniah 1:12 warn against being 'settled on the lees,' portraying it as a state of spiritual stagnation and false security. Psalms 75:8 uses the imagery of dregs to depict the fate of the wicked, emphasizing God’s sovereign judgment over those who persist in unrighteousness.
